content.short: Hundreds of Bitcoin and Ethereum onchain metrics live on Glassnode, used by traders, funds and researchers.
content.description: Glassnode turns raw blockchain data into market signals, such as how long coins have been held, what different holder groups are doing, miner flows and exchange balances. Glassnode Studio charts these metrics, the API delivers them to trading systems, and the research team publishes regular market reports. Much of the onchain analysis shared in crypto media starts with Glassnode data. The platform now covers more than 1,700 metrics across over 1,500 assets, including futures, options, ETFs and digital asset treasuries, with history going back more than fifteen years. The company spun out of Swissblock and has served data since 2017.
